post.description: Pass `customerId` in the path and `year` + `month` in the body (UTC calendar month). Returns one short-lived HMAC download URL per API-displayed vIBAN for that customer (Luxembourg `LU*` / `DEFAULT_VIBAN_COUNTRY_CODE` only — same set as Address list; CDA and FDA, including closed; DE/GB and other country prefixes are omitted). Each PDF lists bank-settled transactions only (`bankStatus` PROCESSED or APPROVED); request status is ignored (e.g. FAILED + PROCESSED is included). FDA COBO also includes 1P3P redeem inbound legs (CDA→FDA, `TOKENS_REDEEMED` credited via `addressBank`). PDFs are not stored; each download URL regenerates the statement on request.
